[SWS_DM_01385] SOVD mode communication_control get value
⌈
The
SOVD attribute value in the response body of SOVD method Get Details of a
Single Mode of an Entity of SOVD mode communication_control shall re-
turn the current state of the Diagnostic Server instance according to Service
CommunicationControl (0x28) of ISO 14229-1[1].
⌋
